Subject: Novum Health — post-demo stakeholder map & procurement next steps

Hi Aisha,

Thanks again for your time on today’s demo — appreciated the candid discussion about throughput needs and the data residency constraints. Quick recap and proposed next steps so we keep momentum: 

1) Stakeholder map (as we heard today)
   - Economic buyer: likely Adam Ross (VP Digital Transformation) — please confirm.
   - Security lead: you mentioned a central InfoSec team (we should engage the security reviewer early).
   - Procurement: procurement@novumhealth.com (please confirm contact + SLA expectations).

2) Decision criteria we captured
   - Latency SLO for inference: 75th pct < 200ms for interactive flows
   - Data residency: US-only, VPC/private deployment required for PHI-adjacent workflows
   - Unit economics: target cost per 1k tokens < $2.50 equivalent (after batching/quant)

3) Immediate next steps (proposal)
   - You: confirm economic buyer and procurement/security contacts (ideally names + emails).
   - We (Redwood): prepare a 1-page mutual action plan (attached) + a short security/RFI summary for initial screening.
   - Schedule: propose a 30-min procurement/contract kickoff early next week and an InfoSec intro the week after.

Attachments: Novum_Health_MA_plan_v1.xlsx (mutual action plan stub) and Novum_Security_RFI_responses.docx (high-level answers).

If that aligns, I’ll send calendar invites and a concise two-page pricing note for the pilot (canary pilot: 4–6 weeks, scoped to 2 endpoints).

Best,

—Sean Gallagher
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
sean.gallagher@redwoodinference.com | +1 (415) 555-0192

Thanks, Sean — great summary.

Confirming contacts:
 - Economic buyer: Adam Ross (adam.ross@novumhealth.com, +1 617-222-3344) — he owns the digital transformation budget.
 - Procurement: Larry White (larry.white@novumhealth.com) – copies procurement@novumhealth.com on procurement questions.
 - Security reviewer: info.security@novumhealth.com (primary contact: Priya Malhotra, priya.malhotra@novumhealth.com).

We’re aligned on the decision criteria you listed. A couple of clarifications:
 - For data residency we require a documented KMS integration plan and SOC-2 evidence (summary is fine at this stage).
 - For cost target — we’ll need an example cost calc tied to our projected 200M tokens/month baseline.

I’ve looped in Larry for procurement scheduling. He should suggest available times for a kickoff.

Onwards,
Aisha
Director, Product Strategy — Novum Health

Great thread — thanks Sean and Aisha. A few operational notes from our side: 

- Procurement kickoff: we typically run a short 30–45 minute session to cover contracting cadence, billing terms, and typical lead times for Dedicated/Private deployments. We’ll bring our commercial template and a list of common redlines to accelerate the legal review.

- Security/Compliance: Karthik and I will prepare a condensed evidence pack (SOC 2 summary, KMS integration notes, and network isolation appendix). Karthik — can you own the RFI draft and drop into the Drive folder by EOD Tuesday?

- Pilot pricing: Sean — I’ll draft a pilot pricing sheet tied to the 4–6 week canary scope Sean proposed and include an example monthly token-cost model at 200M tokens. Will share as a simple spreadsheet.

Proposed meeting windows sent to Larry once he replies — we’ll include calendar options that map to Adam’s availability if you share it.

Sean / Aisha — looping in procurement formally. We generally run the following timeline for vendor onboarding: 

1) Initial commercial review + MSAs (1–2 weeks)
2) Security review + RFI follow-up (2–3 weeks concurrent)
3) PO issuance and billing setup (1 week after legal sign-off)

Attached is our PO template and a short list of standard clauses we expect to see (Novum_PO_Template.pdf). Please provide a clean MSA and the security evidence pack; if you can get those to us by end of next week we can target a March 15th go/no-go decision with contracting to follow.

Also: Adam is looped on a separate thread — he requested an example SLA and pilot acceptance criteria doc. If you can surface a one-page SLA and the pilot success metrics that would be helpful.

Thanks — Larry
